Sonic modulus test on RC2 soil at relative density 0.82; apparatus: shock tube using compressed air; piezoelectric stress gages at each end of a triaxial specimen; oscilloscope arrival times; loading: stress wave from the shock tube driver pressurized to the same pressure each time (peak stress somewhat less than 2 psi); confining pressure by partial vacuum inside a rubber diaphragm. Recorded: modulus vs confining pressure. One of 2 tests drawn from the same figures.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
The numbers below were digitized from the published figure by two readings made separately; they agree within the stated reading bounds at 20 of the 22 points, and the rest were settled against the scan. They have not yet been checked by a person. The test setup is incomplete: unit weight, tool, bin or mold, fill depth, rate are not reported.
:::

## Data

Error bars are reading bounds (half-widths from the digitization), not standard deviations. Filled markers were agreed by both readings, hollow ones were not.](../img/plots/b68-sonic-fb-6-dr82.png){.lightbox}

Peak modulus E = ρc² (wave velocity) 183.48 MPa at 69.0 kPa confining pressure, the end of the record.

Download: [observations.csv](../files/data/experiments/b68-sonic-fb-6-dr82/observations.csv) (22 points: 7 plotted symbols, 12 samples of the drawn curve; columns `x_si`, `y_si` with bounds `x_bound_si`, `y_bound_si`; panel 1: modulus E = ρc² (wave velocity) in Pa against confining pressure in Pa; the printed-unit values, the pixel position on the scan and the review status of each point are kept in further columns) and [series.json](../files/data/experiments/b68-sonic-fb-6-dr82/series.json) (units, conversion factors, how the points were read).

Reading bounds on this figure (how far our reading of the printed figure may be off, not the uncertainty of the test): typical bound 228 Pa in confining pressure, 227.4 kPa in modulus E = ρc² (0.1 percent of the peak). Both independent readings agree within these bounds at 20 of the 22 points; the other 2 were settled against the scan (read by one reader and verified by the other, or decided between two readings). [Check the digitized points against the scan](../figures/index.qmd#check-fb-6).
